name: Corrupting My Girlfriend in Another World
source:
You and your girlfriend fall into a parallel world while investigating a gossip that circulates around the city of Sirua. Discover or join the plot of the kingdom of Dulobia and the power that rules in Vesteria.

Your adventure in that world begins to awaken something you have never experienced before - choosing between building up your relationship or satisfying the perverse desire to corrupt your girlfriend Sakiko and watch her with other men.

Will they make it to the end of the adventure without falling into darkness? Or will they surrender to their deepest desires? You will choose their fate.

[From [url=https://r1leyd4rk.itch.io/corrupting-my-girlfriend-in-another-world]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你与女友在调查Sirua城流传的传闻时，落入了一个平行世界。你将揭开或参与Dulobia王国的阴谋，探索统治Vesteria的力量。

异世界的冒险唤醒了你从未体验过的冲动：究竟是加深彼此的感情，还是满足那种让女友Sakiko堕落、看她与其他男人在一起的扭曲欲望？

他们能否走到冒险的终点，而不坠入黑暗？还是会屈从于内心最深处的欲望？他们的命运由你选择。

[摘自[url=https://r1leyd4rk.itch.io/corrupting-my-girlfriend-in-another-world]itch.io[/url]]
